arabic text: Zahra ki duaon ki hifazat me rahega
english translation text: It will remain protected by Zahra's prayers.

arabic text: Kehta hy ye her ek azadar gharana\nKyun hum ko dhamakon say darata hy zamana\nKum ho ga na matam kabhi din rat barhay ga
english translation text: Every household of mourners declares:\nwhy does the world try to frighten us with explosions?\nOur matam will never decrease; it will grow day and night.

arabic text: Kub hy wo wahan us ko jahan dhoondh rahay ho\nTum warisay matam ko kahan dhoondh rahay ho\nWo halqa e matam ma kaheen Tum ko milay ga
english translation text: When is he there, in the place where you are searching for him?\nWhere are you looking for the heir of matam?\nYou will find him somewhere within a circle of mourning.

arabic text: Hara hy sitam majlis e Shabir na hari\nAllah ka wada hy rahegi yunhi jari\nMit jaiaygi dunia kabhi matam na rukay ga
english translation text: Oppression has been defeated, but Shabbir's majlis has never been defeated.\nAllah has promised that it will continue forever.\nThe world may disappear, but matam will never stop.

arabic text: Ye qarz na utrayga kabhi ta ba qayamat\nTurbat me Bhi jari hi rahegi ye ibadat\nMarnay say kahan matam e Shabir rukayga
english translation text: This debt will never be repaid, even until Judgement Day.\nThis worship will continue even within the grave.\nHow could Shabbir's matam stop merely because of death?

arabic text: Ik rooz bulaiayga hamain waris e matam\nLehraiayga chat per meray ghazi ka wo percham\nKaba abhi Sarwar ka azakhana banayga
english translation text: One day, the heir of matam will summon us;\nhe will raise my Ghazi's standard upon the roof.\nThe Kaaba will yet become Sarwar's mourning house.

arabic text: Matam tera ada humain kernay nai daytay\nYe wada kiya lash pa bhai ke behan nay\nAub farshay aza sham ke zindaan me bichayga
english translation text: They do not allow us to perform your matam.\nThis promise was made by the sister over her brother's body:\nnow the mourning floor will be spread inside Shaam's prison.

arabic text: Durray Bhi lagain gay na magar peeche hategi\nZainab ki aseeri bhi bara kaam karaygi\nBazoo pa nishaa(n) rassi ka ye bat likhayga
english translation text: The lashes may strike, but she will not retreat;\nZainab's captivity will accomplish a great mission.\nThe marks of ropes upon her arms will write this truth.

arabic text: Ye Fatima Zehra Ki Takallum hai 'Karimi'\nBibi Ke duaon se hai khilqat huwi apni\nZahra ki dua jo hai wo matam tu karayga
english translation text: O "Karimi", this matam itself is Fatima Zahra's prayer.\nOur very creation is through the Lady's prayers;\nwhoever carries Zahra's prayer will surely perform matam.
